question: Does a directly written reusable foundation of concepts and observed relation structure improve native-style construction of unseen causal compositions under a fixed intervention budget, compared to identical information without structured priming and strong fully fitted conventional/symbolic controls?
hypothesis: A foundation of prior public transformation relationships plus executable compositional representation improves held-world sample efficiency or total-process efficiency without impairing retention. It is a testable hypothesis, not an established result. Correctly distinguish genuinely novel compositions from discovery of new primitives outside the admitted grammar.
predecessor_evidence: Issue #1088 operator conditional-integration objective; not model promotion authority.
PR #1018 AAI-01 identical numeric associations tie exact symbolic and converged logistic; avoid identical two-route task.
PR #1031 AAI-05 prior motif catalog underperforms exact Bayes and is not native-model integration.
PR #1087 ST9 matches fully trained active conventional controls and fails new-cubic-rule transfer.
Issue #910 WSP continual direct-weight programming north star; no accepted changes.
Native control at main yggdrasil/public_causal_cells.py has 16 addresses and 128 learned counter bytes; not suitable for storing this foundation without a separate tested native-memory extension.

inputs.name: FKP01-SRC-V1 synthetic source-generator specification (NOT source-code hash; original source still requires independent pre-primary pin)
inputs.source: SHA-256 UTF-8 canonical specification: FKP01-SRC-V1|python=3.12|states=128|primitive_maps=16|public_primitive_edges=2048|law=ordered_composition_of_3_or_4_primitive_maps|foundation_seeds=100..131|development_worlds=200..215|primary_worlds=1000..1063|negative_worlds=2000..2015|intervention_indices=16_per_world|held_indices=all_128|worlds_fixed_split|no_private_rule_access. Generated finite-state public causal permutation families only. No external restricted dataset. Source generator implementation and its Git blob must be committed, independently reviewed, and immutable before any original primary labels are generated.

seeds.foundation: 100..131 inclusive; these 32 independently seeded historical worlds are the only source of initial reusable training knowledge
seeds.development: 200..215 inclusive; DEBUG/DEV only, no scientific claims
seeds.primary: 1000..1063 inclusive; 64 disjoint untouched worlds, equally split between 3- and 4-step causal composition families
seeds.negative: 2000..2015 inclusive; disjoint non-compositional permutation laws; no target fitting
seeds.retention: 3000..3015 inclusive; independent interference worlds; do not overwrite first-task checkpoint

frozen_design.split: Every world exposes 128 distinct nonlinguistic public concept IDs and 16 public primitive transformation maps (2,048 directed edges). Hidden world law is an ordered 3- or 4-map composition. No candidate or comparison arm sees hidden operator identities or withheld outputs. The foundation consists of the same 32 past-world map graphs, 16 observed intervention/outcome examples per world and their provenance for every arm. No world identity, private random seed or target rule supplied to learner.
frozen_design.ordering: Source code must use Python 3.12 random.Random(seed) for immutable generated public mappings and private law selection, with strictly separate RNG streams for intervention/held points. All 16 preaction intervention inputs are frozen deterministically from the public state domain before any outcome; the identical 16 source actions are supplied to every arm. Additionally, report separate adaptive action-selection results as exploratory only. 128 withheld preaction public inputs per world are evaluated cold, without training.
frozen_design.data_budget: 32 prior worlds x 2,048 known primitive edges +16 observed intervention outcomes per world (65,536 original public edges +512 paid outcomes), followed by 16 paid actions per development/primary world; never expose private law identities or non-observed held outcomes to candidate or controls.
frozen_design.compute_budget: No model API or GPUs. Each arm must record initialization cost, training/fit time, original source-action count, wall+CPU inference and full-process cost, peak memory, serialized retained bytes, static code/prior memory, source generation and normalization cost. Count any composition search caches, temporary candidate lists and compilation. Precommit max 16 selected training actions and <=200,000 candidate expression evaluations/world/arm; report budget hits and fail any arm that exceeds capacity. A separately independent exact Bayesian/symbolic reference may exceed this computational cap as a reported ceiling, but such asymmetry prohibits claiming algorithmic superiority and requires a cost-matched strongest conventional control.
frozen_design.capacity: Max 128 concepts, 16 primitive operators, 2,048 per-world public relational edges, 65,536 historical edge facts, 512 historical observed consequences and 16 fresh observed consequences/world. Native-style direct-weight structured model cannot carry oracle rule table or exceed its fixed learned-memory budget (to be pinned by source commit before primary). Other arms receive identical facts, equal target information, action counts, and disclosed capacity, including structured vs flat encoding cost.
frozen_design.evaluator: Held-world next-public-state exact accuracy and observed-action consequence accuracy on all 128 states; source-private law is evaluator-only. Report 3-map and 4-map cohorts separately, probability calibration/abstention, false certainty on novel negative law, resource cost, and retention after interference. No self-scoring from world-private coefficients.
frozen_design.source_integrity_gate: This commit freezes the study protocol only. Before protected primary first-use: independently implement and pin exact source generator, rubric, candidate implementations, qualified conventional controls, frozen maps of actual input hashes, numerical validation fixtures and native-memory cap in a separate code commit; complete source-only identifiability and information parity preflight. Never call the protocol commit alone a completed experiment or primary-frozen source.

controls: A minimal foundation, but the same exposed per-world public primitive facts and 16 paid outcomes; do not hide input information.

B structured, directly written native-style concept/relation foundation using only public 32 prior-world experiences; compose new relation structures during training rather than store target rule IDs.
C identical historical facts, counts, and observations as B in flat unstructured association representation, with permissible equal-budget reconstruction.
D same facts with shuffled linkage/signs as a prespecified negative, with explicit invalidation if the shuffle leaks target rules.
B minus relationship construction (same initial facts and fixed learned-state budget); B minus replay; B erased after cold restart.

Independently implemented exact symbolic/Bayesian compositor given same public priors, primitive operators and 16 actions; fully fitted conventional classifier/sequence learner with the same information and pinned convergence/optimization checks.
Independent no-learning lookup and random-assignment controls; input/output permutation, duplicate/erasure, and non-compositional negative laws.
metrics: Primary: held-world exact postaction prediction accuracy on 64 never-trained worlds, reported separately for 3-map and unseen-length 4-map compositions.
Paired within-world improvement over strongest sufficiently trained same-information control; paired bootstrap 95% CI clustered by world (10,000 draws; fixed RNG seed 9090).
Action/sample efficiency to 90% held accuracy at observation prefixes 4,8,12,16; no post-result prefix selection.
Whole-process wall/CPU cost ratio including 32-world prior knowledge construction, 64-world fitting and evaluation, and all cache/memory allocation; memory and retention also measured.
Cold checkpoint exactness, return-to-older-world accuracy after 16 disjoint interference worlds, accidental rule leakage, novel operator abstention and false-certain predictions.
Contrast between primed structured B and equally informed C, unprimed A, shuffled D, with qualitative breakdown of new structural composition vs catalog retrieval.

classification_rules.supported: SCIENTIFIC_CANDIDATE_ONLY if (a) B beats strongest adequately trained cost-matched conventional/reference by >=0.05 absolute held exact accuracy on BOTH 3- and 4-step cohorts with clustered paired 95% CI lower bound >0, OR B matches strongest within 0.005 accuracy on BOTH cohorts AND measured fully accounted end-to-end cost <=0.5x fastest qualified equal-information reference; (b) B improves versus identical-facts unstructured C by >=0.05 on at least one cohort or <=0.5x end-to-end cost with <=0.005 score loss; (c) retention loss <=0.01, zero observed oracle leakage, zero asserted certainty on clearly underidentified negatives, and source/control parity/first-use integrity PASS. Separate independently disjoint source replication is mandatory before SCIENTIFIC_PASS and native admission.
classification_rules.mixed: Valid pre-registered B gain against C but tie or loss against strongest fair reference, or gain only one family, or a partial retention/efficiency condition fails: report MIXED_DEV, NO_INTEGRATION.
classification_rules.negative: B tied, lost to, or failed any scientific threshold relative to strongest controls under valid matched conditions: NO_GO, preserve results and do not retune the exposed cohort.
classification_rules.invalid: Any leakage, unqualified source/algorithm changes, preprimary source identity missing, nonconverged conventional comparator, action mismatch on primary comparison, unidentifiable target according to independent source audit, insufficient sample for threshold, stale SHA/tree, wrong splits, postresult tweaks, or missing cost accounting. No science claim.
classification_rules.integration: No immediate main-model integration from candidate result; independently replicate on externally authored, genuinely unfamiliar causal law family with strong equal-information baselines, then make smallest actual native substrate/learned-memory change and run full final Linux/Windows regression + G29, native cold-state verification and independently authorized owner acceptance. If no qualified gain, do not modify main.
